Class GUISession<Model, Msg, V extends View<Msg,V,Viewer>, Viewer extends InventoryViewer<Msg,V>, Ctx extends CommandContext>

java.lang.Object
me.bristermitten.mittenlib.gui.session.GUISession<Model,Msg,V,Viewer,Ctx>
public class GUISession<Model, Msg, V extends View<Msg,V,Viewer>, Viewer extends InventoryViewer<Msg,V>, Ctx extends CommandContext> extends Object
Represents an active GUI session with state management and event handling. Follows the Elm architecture pattern with immutable state updates.
